notes: The Hakai Institute maintains a weather and tide station on the main dock of its remote station located on Calvert Island within Pruth Bay. The weather station measures the air temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, atmospheric pressure, UV radiation, solar radiation, PAR, and precipitation since July 2014. In June 2018, a tide station was installed to measure the water level within the bay. The station is a combination of a primary radar sensor mounted below the dock above the water and a secondary vented pressure sensor mounted within the water 2m below the lowest tides.

notes_translated.en: The Hakai Institute maintains a weather and tide station on the main dock of its remote station located on Calvert Island within Pruth Bay. The weather station measures the air temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, atmospheric pressure, UV radiation, solar radiation, PAR, and precipitation since July 2014. In June 2018, a tide station was installed to measure the water level within the bay. The station is a combination of a primary radar sensor mounted below the dock above the water and a secondary vented pressure sensor mounted within the water 2m below the lowest tides.
notes_translated.fr: L'Institut Hakai maintient une station météorologique et marée sur le quai principal de sa station éloignée située sur l'île Calvert, dans la baie de Pruth. La station météorologique mesure la température de l'air, la vitesse et la direction du vent, l'humidité, la pression atmosphérique, le rayonnement UV, le rayonnement solaire, le PAR et les précipitations depuis juillet 2014. En juin 2018, une station de marée a été installée pour mesurer le niveau d'eau dans la baie. La station est une combinaison d'un capteur radar primaire monté sous le quai au-dessus de l'eau et d'un capteur de pression ventilé secondaire monté dans l'eau à 2 m sous les marées les plus basses.
